profile_text.body:
Teradata Corp /DE/ is a public company traded under the ticker TDC, headquartered in San Diego, California, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000816761. On its own website the company describes itself as the AI platform for the autonomous era, connecting and scaling across any environment. It markets an Autonomous Knowledge Platform, which it says makes AI real, trusted, governed, and built to scale, and it presents a portfolio of products and services intended to help organizations use AI, analytics, and cloud solutions. The site also states that the company partners with other providers to supply technology, AI-driven resources, and knowledge.

The site text is largely promotional and does not name individual products, customers, or executives. Its litigation exposure is recorded in California, where 281 matters are counted.
